title: Add the Sevio userId submodule (sevioIdSystem)

requirement_analysis.restatement: Add a Prebid.js userId submodule named `sevioId` (GVL 1393). Its `getId` fetches a Sevio user ID from Sevio's Identity service (`POST https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve`), identified by a required publisher-supplied client ID (`params.clientId`) and, optionally, an email hash (`params.emailHash`). Prebid's core userId storage keeps the ID in a first-party cookie that is read first, with localStorage as the fallback. When only localStorage still holds the ID, the core reads it from there and the cookie is not restored, because nothing besides Prebid core reads the cookie. No ID reaches bids under COPPA, including one already stored. The ID is exposed as an EID (source `adx.ws`), which `sevioBidAdapter` already forwards, and the PR carries the docs a new ID submodule needs.
ambiguities: Design forks resolved by the user on 2026-09-30: ID source = a Sevio server endpoint; persistence = Prebid core storage with `cookie&html5`; missing cookie = originally restored from localStorage when missing; on 2026-10-01 the user confirmed nothing besides Prebid core reads the cookie, so it is no longer restored; EID source = `adx.ws`; bid adapter = unchanged.

Still open, as values only: the defaults under Assumptions, which the user can override without changing the design. The endpoint URL and contract are no longer open: they come from the Identity service doc ("Identity&DMP - Phase 1") the user supplied on 2026-10-02. Resolved by the user on 2026-10-02: the call cadence stays as it is (no call on every page view), the response's `syncs` are ignored, an optional email hash is sent, and the EID source stays `adx.ws`.
contradictions: In Prebid, storage type, name and expiry are publisher config (`userSync.userIds[].storage`). A submodule cannot set storage defaults, and modules writing their own storage are being phased out (PR_REVIEW.md:111). So 'cookie primary, localStorage fallback' is delivered by documenting `cookie&html5` as required and warning when a publisher configures anything else; it cannot be forced.

Core defect: `enforceStorageTypeRule` (modules/userId/index.ts:1299-1317) compares each write's single type with the raw `'cookie&html5'` string. With `userSync.enforceStorageType: true` nothing persists; otherwise every write logs a warning. Fixed in a separate Core PR (task chip raised); the module docs state the caveat until it ships.
The Identity service doc says the AdServer reads the EID whose source is `sevio.com`; the user stated on 2026-10-02 that `sevio.com` is a placeholder there, so the source stays `adx.ws`.

CLAUDE.md discourages `application/json` calls because they add a CORS preflight, but the Identity service answers 415 to any other content type, so the module posts JSON; the backend accepting `text/plain` would remove the preflight.
assumptions: GVL 1393 is the same legal entity as sevioBidAdapter.
The endpoint follows the Identity service's resolve contract (see Decisions).
The module takes a required `params.clientId` and an optional `params.emailHash`.
No ID is provided under COPPA, including an ID already stored (stricter than SharedID, whose stored ID still reaches bids).
The docs recommend storage name `_sevioId` and `expires: 30` days.
out_of_scope: Any sevioBidAdapter change, including its string GVLID (modules/sevioBidAdapter.js:17).
metadata/modules/sevioIdSystem.json (generated by the release process, never hand-edited).
Acting on the resolve response's `changed` flag (user, 2026-10-02); firing its `syncs` was moved into scope on 2026-10-15.
Outside this repo: the Sevio Identity service itself, the prebid.github.io docs PR, and adding the new storage keys to https://sevio.com/tcf.json.
pushback: A browser-generated UUID would duplicate SharedID (pubcid), which the adapter already receives, so the user chose a server-issued ID.
Module-managed cookie and localStorage writes were rejected (review policy; blocked by enforceStorageType and storageControl).
Rewriting both stores on every page view (SharedID `extend`) was rejected because it resets `_last` on each visit and so disables `refreshInSeconds`.

Restoring a missing cookie through extendId was dropped (2026-10-01). Nothing outside Prebid reads the cookie, and the core already falls back to localStorage. The module's own cookie read was checked by storageControl while the core's is not (advertiseKeys: false, modules/userId/index.ts:1178-1184), and it ignored whether cookies are enabled; in both cases it rewrote both stores and reset _last on every page view.

Calling the Identity service on every page view through `extendId`, as the service doc's SDK does (which keeps Safari's 7-day cookie clock running and refreshes the recall hint on every visit), was offered on 2026-10-02 and declined by the user in favour of the existing cadence plus a recommended `storage.refreshInSeconds: 86400`.

non_functional_targets.metric: ID endpoint requests on a page view that already has a valid stored ID (cookie or localStorage)
synchronous network requests made by getId
non_functional_targets.target: 0 (the fetch runs only inside the callback Prebid schedules)

solution_strategy.sub_outcome: Persist the ID, cookie first, localStorage fallback
solution_strategy.existing_capability: Core userId storage: getConfiguredStorageTypes parses the type (modules/userId/index.ts:1037-1039), setStoredValue writes every enabled type (189-209), getStoredValue reads in configured order (270-296)
solution_strategy.layer: publisher config documented in the module docs, plus a config check in getId
solution_strategy.justification: The core already has exactly this read/write order, while module-managed storage is being phased out and is blocked by enforceStorageType and storageControl.

solution_strategy.sub_outcome: Use the ID when the cookie is missing
solution_strategy.existing_capability: getStoredValue falls back to localStorage when the cookie is empty (modules/userId/index.ts:270-296)
solution_strategy.layer: core only (the module has no extendId and no StorageManager)
solution_strategy.justification: Nothing besides the core reads the cookie, so restoring it changes no output. A module-side cookie read is exposed to storageControl and to disabled cookies, and either one turns the restore into a rewrite on every page view. Amended (2026-10-01): replaces the restore-via-extendId sub-outcome (solution-adversary findings 1-2).

solution_strategy.sub_outcome: Suppress the ID under COPPA, including a stored one
solution_strategy.layer: submodule decode, plus the existing getId guard
solution_strategy.justification: The core decodes the stored ID whatever getId returns (modules/userId/index.ts:944-947), so only decode can keep a stored ID out of bids. Amended (2026-10-01): added for solution-adversary finding 3.

Plain ajax silently drops withCredentials for a module that has no metadata yet (src/ajax.ts:149-158, plugins/callerContext.js:12-37). Amended (2026-10-02): the resolve body's privacy object is built in the module rather than with getUserSyncParams, which URL-encodes us_privacy and joins gpp_sid into a string, while the JSON body needs the raw string and an array of numbers.

solution_strategy.sub_outcome: Expose the ID as an EID
solution_strategy.existing_capability: Submodule eids property in function form, which allows a numeric atype (modules/sharedIdSystem.ts:196-206; the object form types atype as a string, modules/userId/spec.ts:123); consumed by the core and already forwarded by modules/sevioBidAdapter.js:335-339
declare module './userId/spec' augmentation of UserId, ProvidersToId and ProviderParams (modules/sharedIdSystem.ts:46-60)
solution_strategy.justification: CLAUDE.md and PR_REVIEW.md:22 ask for typed, exported params. Amended (2026-10-02): SevioIdParams is {clientId: string; emailHash?: string}.

solution_strategy.existing_capability: The userId list in modules/.submodules.json and the doc format of recent ID modules (modules/rediadsIdSystem.md, modules/anonymisedIdSystem.md)

context: Sevio already has a Prebid bid adapter (modules/sevioBidAdapter.js, GVL 1393) that forwards userIdAsEids and userId to https://req.adx.ws/prebid. Sevio now wants its own user ID in Prebid, stored first-party in a cookie (primary) with localStorage as the fallback. Prebid's userId core already supports exactly that through storage.type 'cookie&html5', so the new module concentrates on fetching the ID, keeping it out of bids under COPPA, exposing the EID, types, tests and docs. It never touches storage itself. The Sevio ID endpoint does not exist yet: Step 1 codes against a single constant and the proposed contract, and the end-to-end verification refuses to pass while the placeholder is still in place. Before /ship: add a fork remote (origin is prebid/Prebid.js, and CLAUDE.md forbids PRs from it); have the YouTrack task id ready; install the gh CLI; open the prebid.github.io docs PR (dev-docs/modules/userid-submodules/sevio.md plus a row in dev-docs/modules/userId.md) so it can be linked; add the storage keys listed in Step 2 to https://sevio.com/tcf.json. Suggested PR title: 'Sevio User ID Module: initial release', labels feature + minor. Amended (2026-10-01): cookie restore removed from the module's scope (solution-adversary findings 1-2). Amended (2026-10-02): The endpoint now exists: Sevio's Identity service, `POST https://id.sevio.com/identity/resolve`, specified in the "Identity&DMP - Phase 1" doc the user supplied on 2026-10-02. `ID_ENDPOINT` points at it, so the end-to-end placeholder gate passes and stays as a regression guard. Amended (2026-10-06): the final Identity service host is id.adx.ws (user, 2026-10-06), so ID_ENDPOINT is now https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve; the path and the request contract are unchanged.

decisions.decision: The ID comes from a Sevio server endpoint, not from the browser.
decisions.rationale: A browser UUID would duplicate SharedID and draw review pushback.

decisions.decision: Persistence is Prebid core storage with storage.type 'cookie&html5'; the module never writes storage.
decisions.rationale: The core already reads the cookie first and falls back to localStorage; module-managed writes are being phased out.

decisions.decision: No cookie restore. The module has no extendId and no StorageManager. When the cookie is missing, the core reads the ID from localStorage, and the cookie stays missing until the next getId (refresh, expiry or a consent change) rewrites both stores.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-01): this replaces the original decision, under which extendId returned {id: storedId} when the cookie was missing. The user confirmed nothing besides Prebid core reads the cookie. The restore's module-side read was checked by storageControl (strict by default) while the core's is not, and it ignored whether cookies are enabled; either one made it rewrite both stores and reset _last on every page view.

decisions.decision: EID source is adx.ws, with atype 1.
decisions.rationale: Reviewers require the provider's real domain; adx.ws is the domain Sevio's ad serving runs on (req.adx.ws), and atype 1 marks a device-based ID. Amended (2026-10-02): Reaffirmed by the user on 2026-10-02: the Identity service doc's `sevio.com` source is a placeholder.
It already forwards userIdAsEids and userId.

decisions.decision: ID_ENDPOINT = 'https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve', the real Identity service endpoint.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-02): this replaces the placeholder decision (https://sevio-id-endpoint.invalid/id), now that the user has supplied the Identity service doc. Amended (2026-10-06): the host changed from id.sevio.com to id.adx.ws, the final Identity service host chosen by the user.

decisions.decision: The endpoint contract is the Identity service's public resolve: POST with Content-Type: application/json, sent with credentials. The body is {client_id, ids?, privacy}: ids holds sevio:<stored envelope> and email_sha256:<hash> when present, and privacy holds gdpr (0/1; 0 when Prebid has no boolean gdprApplies, amended 2026-10-15), gdpr_consent, us_privacy, gpp and gpp_sid (an array of positive section ids; the GPP CMP's -1 is left out). The answer is {sevio_id, changed, syncs?}; sevio_id is used, and syncs are fired (amended 2026-10-15).
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-02): this replaces the planner's proposed GET contract with the contract in the Identity service doc. The service answers 415 to a content type other than application/json, so the text/plain preflight saving of the GET proposal is not available.

decisions.decision: TypeScript module with inline types; name and decode key sevioId; numeric gvlid 1393.
decisions.rationale: PR_REVIEW.md:22 and :98-100; TCF vendor checks need the GVL ID registered under the module name.

decisions.decision: getId requires storage: without it the module logs an error and returns nothing; a storage.type other than cookie&html5 logs a warning but still works.
decisions.rationale: Without storage the endpoint would be hit on every page view and nothing would persist; the storage choice stays with the publisher.

decisions.decision: No ID under COPPA: getId makes no request when consentData.coppa is set, and decode returns undefined when coppaDataHandler.getCoppa() is true, so an ID already stored never reaches bids. Other consent signals are forwarded to the endpoint.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-01): the core decodes the stored ID whatever getId returns (modules/userId/index.ts:944-947), so a getId-only guard, as in SharedID, still leaks a stored ID. GDPR is already enforced by Prebid's TCF checks for GVL 1393, and the remaining signals are the server's to act on.

decisions.decision: No domainOverride, so the cookie is host-only, like localStorage.
decisions.rationale: Not requested. findRootDomain returns an invalid cookie domain on hosts with a port (e.g. localhost dev pages), and domainOverrideToRootDomain adds a probe cookie that would need disclosing. Easy to add later if Sevio wants the ID shared across subdomains.

decisions.decision: The docs recommend storage.name '_sevioId' and expires 30; maintainer is technical@sevio.com.
decisions.rationale: One fixed recommended name lets https://sevio.com/tcf.json disclose the exact keys; 30 days is a conservative default the user can change; the maintainer matches modules/sevioBidAdapter.md.

decisions.decision: params.clientId is required: when it is missing, blank or not a string, getId logs an error and returns nothing, so no request is made.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-02): The Identity service answers 400 without a non-blank client_id; the user's wrapper supplies its own value.

decisions.decision: params.emailHash is optional. It is trimmed and lowercased, then sent as email_sha256:<64 hex> after the stored envelope. Any other shape logs a warning and is not sent. The module never stores it.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-02): Requested by the user on 2026-10-02. One malformed entry in ids gets the whole request refused with 400, so an invalid hash is dropped rather than sent.

decisions.decision: The call cadence is unchanged: no extendId, and a request is made only when nothing is stored, when consent changes, or when storage.refreshInSeconds elapses. The docs recommend refreshInSeconds: 86400.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-02): Chosen by the user on 2026-10-02 over calling on every page view. A refresh presents the stored envelope and stores the resealed answer.

decisions.decision: The resolve response's syncs are fired; changed is ignored. A sync fires only when the response carries a non-empty string sevio_id, and only for an entry whose url is an https string (any other entry is skipped with logWarn). Each URL must pass isActivityAllowed(ACTIVITY_SYNC_USER, activityParams(MODULE_TYPE_UID, 'sevioId', {syncType: 'image', syncUrl: url})), so TCF Purpose 1 and vendor 1393, userSync.syncEnabled and activity controls (including US-state rules) apply; userSync.filterSettings does not, because it only covers bidders. It is fired with politeTriggerPixel. The module keeps no storage for this: syncs fire only when it calls the service (nothing stored, refreshInSeconds elapsed, consent change), and each entry's ttl is ignored.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-15): this replaces the 2026-10-02 decision to ignore syncs and changed. The user chose firing in the ID module over routing the syncs through sevioBidAdapter.getUserSyncs, after being told reviewers may push back because it bypasses filterSettings and fires a partner's pixels. The docs say how to block them.

decisions.decision: The stored ID is presented as sevio:<id> only when it is 66 base64url characters. A null sevio_id logs info and yields no ID; any other malformed answer logs an error.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-02): A malformed ids entry gets the whole request refused with 400. A null answer is the service's normal refusal (privacy or agent gate), not a fault.

decisions.decision: coppa is not sent in privacy.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-02): Under COPPA getId makes no request at all, so a request that is sent could only ever carry coppa: 0, and Prebid's ORTB convention omits the flag when it does not apply.

decisions.decision: privacy.gdpr defaults to 0 when Prebid has no boolean gdprApplies (no TCF consent management configured); a boolean gdprApplies is still sent as 0 or 1.
decisions.rationale: Amended (2026-10-15): chosen by the user on 2026-10-15 after being told that it asserts GDPR does not apply when nothing determined the scope, and that it disables the Identity service's no-consent-signal refusal for gdpr. The docs tell publishers with EU traffic to include consentManagementTcf.

steps.title: Add the sevioId userId submodule with tests
steps.goal: Prebid can load a `sevioId` userId submodule that fetches the Sevio ID from Sevio's Identity service, relies on core `cookie&html5` storage (cookie first, localStorage fallback), provides no ID under COPPA even when one is stored, and emits an `adx.ws` EID, covered by unit tests and tests that run through the core's storage.
planned_changes: modules/sevioIdSystem.ts: header docblock as in modules/sharedIdSystem.ts:1-6.

modules/sevioIdSystem.ts constants: MODULE_NAME = 'sevioId', GVLID = 1393, ID_ENDPOINT = 'https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve', EID_SOURCE = 'adx.ws', LOG_PREFIX = 'sevioId: ', ENVELOPE_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{66}$/, EMAIL_HASH_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.

export type SevioIdParams = { clientId: string; emailHash?: string }, each field documented, and a declare module './userId/spec' block adding UserId { sevioId: string }, ProvidersToId { sevioId: 'sevioId' } and ProviderParams { sevioId: SevioIdParams }.

export const sevioIdSubmodule: IdProviderSpec<typeof MODULE_NAME> with name and gvlid; decode(value) returns undefined when coppaDataHandler.getCoppa() is true, otherwise {sevioId: value} for a non-empty string and undefined for anything else.

getId(config, consentData, storedId), in order: (1) consentData?.coppa set -> logInfo and return undefined; (2) config.params.clientId missing, blank or not a string -> logError and return undefined; (3) config.storage missing -> logError and return undefined; (4) storage types (split on &, trimmed) not exactly ['cookie', 'html5'] -> logWarn recommending cookie&html5, then continue; (5) return {callback}, where the callback posts JSON.stringify({client_id, ids?, privacy}) with qualifiedAjaxBuilder(MODULE_TYPE_UID, MODULE_NAME)(ID_ENDPOINT, {success, error}, body, {method: 'POST', contentType: 'application/json', withCredentials: true}); buildIds(storedId, emailHash) adds sevio:<storedId> when the stored ID matches ENVELOPE_PATTERN, then email_sha256:<hash> when emailHash, trimmed and lowercased, matches EMAIL_HASH_PATTERN (a set emailHash of any other shape logs a warning and is not sent; ids is left out when empty); buildPrivacy(consentData) sets gdpr (Number(gdprApplies) when boolean, otherwise 0), gdpr_consent, us_privacy (raw string), gpp and gpp_sid (the positive integers in applicableSections, left out when none), and no coppa; (6) success parses the JSON: a non-empty string sevio_id is passed on, a null one -> logInfo then callback(), anything else -> logError then callback(); with a non-empty string sevio_id, each syncs entry whose url is an https string and passes the syncUser activity check (MODULE_TYPE_UID, sevioId, syncType 'image') is fired with politeTriggerPixel, and any other entry is skipped with logWarn; changed is ignored; (7) error -> logError then callback().
No extendId: with a valid stored ID the core only decodes it, so nothing is written and no request is made.
eids: { sevioId: (values) => ({ source: EID_SOURCE, uids: values.map(id => ({ id, atype: 1 })) }) }, then submodule('userId', sevioIdSubmodule).
modules/.submodules.json: insert "sevioIdSystem" between "rewardedInterestIdSystem" and "sharedIdSystem" in parentModules.userId.

test/spec/modules/sevioIdSystem_spec.js unit tests: name and gvlid; decode, including undefined under COPPA (config.setConfig({coppa: true})); getId (COPPA; missing, blank or non-string clientId; missing storage; warning for a non-recommended type; no request before the callback runs; POST method, credentials, JSON content type and body: client_id, privacy with gdpr 1 and 0, gpp_sid with and without -1 or sections, privacy of {gdpr: 0} without consent data and with a gdpr object that has no gdprApplies; ids with a stored envelope, an email hash (lowercased and trimmed), both in that order, and without a non-envelope stored ID or an invalid hash, which warns; success, null sevio_id, missing / empty / non-string sevio_id, invalid JSON and HTTP error responses; syncs: allowed https entries fired with politeTriggerPixel after a syncUser check with the right params, none fired when the activity is denied or sevio_id is null, and non-https or invalid entries skipped with a warning); extendId is not defined; EID shape via createEidsArray(sevioIdSubmodule.decode('abc'), new Map(Object.entries(sevioIdSubmodule.eids))).

test/spec/modules/sevioIdSystem_spec.js through-core tests with params {clientId} and storage {type: 'cookie&html5', name: '_sevioId', expires: 30}: cookie and localStorage hold different IDs -> the cookie's ID is used and localStorage is untouched; only localStorage holds the ID -> it is used, no endpoint request is made, and no _sevioId cookie is written; nothing stored -> one request with no ids, and responding with {"sevio_id": <envelope>} writes _sevioId to both the cookie and localStorage; a stored envelope whose _sevioId_last is older than refreshInSeconds 86400 -> one request presents sevio:<stored>, and the resealed answer replaces the ID in both stores; a valid stored ID with COPPA on (config.setConfig({coppa: true}), then seed _sevioId_cst with getConsentHash()) -> getUserIds() has no sevioId, no adx.ws EID is produced, and no endpoint request is made.
steps.notes: In the through-core tests, seed _sevioId_cst with getConsentHash() (and a future _sevioId_exp for localStorage); otherwise the core sees a consent change and calls getId instead of only decoding the stored ID. Between tests, reset consent state and call config.resetConfig() (which also clears coppa), then expire or remove every _sevioId* key (COOKIE_SUFFIXES / HTML5_SUFFIXES). The module never reads or writes storage; storageControl and cookie availability only affect the core's own reads and writes, and its manager uses advertiseKeys: false (modules/userId/index.ts:1178-1184). Known trade-off: once the cookie is lost (e.g. Safari's 7-day cap on cookies set by script), the ID lives only in localStorage until the next getId rewrites both stores. Amended (2026-10-01): dropped extendId and the module StorageManager, and moved the COPPA guard into decode with a through-core test (solution-adversary findings 1-3; the user confirmed nothing besides Prebid core reads the cookie). Amended (2026-10-02): the module calls the real Identity service: a JSON POST with client_id, ids and privacy that reads sevio_id. params.clientId (required) and params.emailHash (optional) were added, the EID source stays adx.ws, and the cadence is unchanged (user decisions; Identity service doc received). Amended (2026-10-06): ID_ENDPOINT and the endpoint acceptance criterion now use https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve, the final host chosen by the user; the path and contract are unchanged. Amended (2026-10-15): privacy.gdpr defaults to 0 when Prebid has no boolean gdprApplies; the tests send {gdpr: 0} without consent data and for a gdpr object with no gdprApplies (user decision, 2026-10-15). Amended (2026-10-15): the module fires the response's syncs behind the syncUser activity check with politeTriggerPixel; the success handler, tests and acceptance criterion changed (user decision, 2026-10-15).
acceptance_criteria: decode('abc') returns {sevioId: 'abc'}; decode(undefined), decode('') and decode({}) return undefined; with COPPA on, decode('abc') returns undefined.

getId returns undefined and makes 0 requests when consentData.coppa is true, when params.clientId is missing, blank or not a string, or when config.storage is missing (the last two also log an error).
getId with a valid config returns {callback}, and 0 requests are made until the callback runs (target: 0 synchronous network requests).

Running the callback issues one POST to ID_ENDPOINT (https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve) with withCredentials true and Content-Type: application/json. The body is client_id plus privacy (gdpr as 0 or 1, and 0 when Prebid has no boolean gdprApplies, gdpr_consent, us_privacy, gpp, and gpp_sid as an array of positive section ids), with no coppa. ids holds sevio:<stored envelope> when the stored ID is a 66-character envelope and email_sha256:<hash> for a valid params.emailHash, in that order, and is left out when empty. An invalid emailHash logs a warning and is not sent.

A response with a string sevio_id passes it to the callback; each of its syncs entries with an https url that passes the syncUser activity check is fired once with politeTriggerPixel; denied, non-https or invalid entries are not fired, and no sync is fired with a null sevio_id; a null sevio_id passes nothing and logs no error; a missing, empty or non-string sevio_id, invalid JSON or an HTTP error passes nothing and logs an error.
sevioIdSubmodule.extendId is undefined, and modules/sevioIdSystem.ts creates no StorageManager.

Through the core with cookie&html5: the cookie value wins over localStorage; with only localStorage that ID is used, 0 endpoint requests are made and no cookie is written; a fetched ID lands in both stores; page views with a valid stored ID make 0 endpoint requests (target: 0); with a valid stored ID and COPPA on, there is no sevioId in getUserIds(), no adx.ws EID, and 0 endpoint requests. A stored envelope past refreshInSeconds is presented as sevio:<stored>, and the resealed answer replaces it in both stores.
Line coverage of modules/sevioIdSystem.ts is at least 80% in the single-spec run.
Lint (without auto-fix), gulp ts and gulp ts-strict pass.

steps.title: Document the Sevio ID submodule
steps.goal: Publishers and reviewers get docs that match the code: a module page with the required `cookie&html5` config, plus entries in the shared userId EID and config references.
planned_changes: modules/sevioIdSystem.md, following modules/rediadsIdSystem.md and modules/anonymisedIdSystem.md: Overview block with Module Name: Sevio User ID Submodule, Module Type: UserID Module, Maintainer: technical@sevio.com; a description of what the ID is, that it comes from Sevio's Identity service (https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve), and when a request is made (nothing stored, refreshInSeconds elapsed, consent change).
Build instructions in modules/sevioIdSystem.md: gulp build --modules=userId,sevioIdSystem (add consentManagementTcf,tcfControl for EU traffic).

Example in modules/sevioIdSystem.md: pbjs.setConfig({userSync: {userIds: [{name: 'sevioId', params: {clientId: 'your-sevio-client-id'}, storage: {type: 'cookie&html5', name: '_sevioId', expires: 30, refreshInSeconds: 86400}}]}}).

Param table in modules/sevioIdSystem.md: name (exactly sevioId); params and params.clientId (required); params.emailHash (optional SHA-256 hex; an invalid value logs a warning and is not sent); storage.type (cookie&html5 required, other values log a warning); storage.name; storage.expires (required; without it the cookie is session-only and localStorage is ignored); storage.refreshInSeconds (recommended, 86400); bidders (optional).

Email hash section in modules/sevioIdSystem.md: the hash is sent only with a request; pbjs.refreshUserIds({ submoduleNames: ['sevioId'] }) sends a newly known hash at once; normalise the address the same way on every site; the module never stores it. Storage section in modules/sevioIdSystem.md: the cookie is read first and localStorage is the fallback; a missing cookie is not restored until the next fetch (refresh, expiry or a consent change) rewrites both stores; keys Prebid writes are cookies _sevioId, _sevioId_cst, _sevioId_last and localStorage _sevioId, _sevioId_exp, _sevioId_cst, _sevioId_last; without storage the module is inactive.

User syncs section in modules/sevioIdSystem.md (amended 2026-10-15): the module fires the partner sync URLs the Identity service returns, only with an issued ID and only on a request (so at most once per refreshInSeconds); each passes Prebid's syncUser check (TCF Purpose 1 and vendor 1393, userSync.syncEnabled, activity controls); userSync.filterSettings does not apply; block them with userSync.syncEnabled: false or an activity control on syncUser for sevioId.

Consent section in modules/sevioIdSystem.md: GVL 1393 (TCF purpose 1 is needed for storage); the request is a credentialed JSON POST carrying client_id, the stored ID and email hash when present, and the consent signals in a privacy object; the Identity service provides no ID when the privacy signals refuse it; gdpr is sent as 0 when Prebid has no GDPR scope (no TCF consent management), so publishers with EU traffic must include consentManagementTcf (amended 2026-10-15; this replaces "or when the page carries no consent signal at all"); no ID under COPPA, including one already stored; the userSync.enforceStorageType: true caveat until the Core fix ships. Then an EID output example.
modules/userId/eids.md: add the adx.ws EID example in the same format as the neighbouring entries.
modules/userId/userId.md: add a sevioId entry (with params.clientId and refreshInSeconds) to the example userIds config, in the same style as the neighbouring entries.
acceptance_criteria: modules/sevioIdSystem.md exists; its example config uses name: 'sevioId' and type: 'cookie&html5', and names no params the code does not accept.
The module doc lists the storage keys, the EID source adx.ws, and the enforceStorageType caveat.
The module doc documents params.clientId (required), params.emailHash (optional) and the endpoint https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve.
modules/userId/eids.md contains an adx.ws entry with atype: 1.
modules/userId/userId.md contains a sevioId example entry.

grep -q "cookie&html5" modules/sevioIdSystem.md && \
grep -q "enforceStorageType" modules/sevioIdSystem.md && \
grep -q "adx.ws" modules/sevioIdSystem.md && \
grep -q "clientId" modules/sevioIdSystem.md && \
grep -q "emailHash" modules/sevioIdSystem.md && \
grep -q "id.adx.ws/identity/resolve" modules/sevioIdSystem.md && \
grep -q "adx.ws" modules/userId/eids.md && \
grep -q "sevioId" modules/userId/userId.md
steps.notes: Amended (2026-10-01): the docs now say the cookie is not restored and that a stored ID is suppressed under COPPA (solution-adversary findings 1-3). Amended (2026-10-02): the docs describe the Identity service request, params.clientId and params.emailHash, and recommend refreshInSeconds: 86400; the EID examples keep adx.ws (user decisions; Identity service doc received). Amended (2026-10-06): the description, the endpoint acceptance criterion and the verification grep now use https://id.adx.ws/identity/resolve, the final host chosen by the user. Amended (2026-10-15): the consent section says gdpr defaults to 0 without TCF consent management and that EU traffic needs consentManagementTcf, replacing the no-consent-signal line (user decision, 2026-10-15). Amended (2026-10-15): added a User syncs section to the module doc (user decision, 2026-10-15).
